verdict.detail: Same country, catalogue number and year as the first issue (UK, DATA012, 2017). Discogs lists 3 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
Music from the 1988 video game // All music composed by Master // Audio sourced from a Japanese Model I Mega Drive (AV Inteligent Terminal VA I motherboard) with stereo output mod // Captured in 24bit/96kHz and mastered for vinyl by Shaun Crook, February 2017

Sourced from a Japanese Mega Drive and carefully mastered for vinyl, Altered Beast is presented as a 45RPM cut LP in a 400g matt varnished sleeve and printed inner sleeve, both of which feature hand-painted artwork from the SEGA archives. Also included is a foldout poster of the original painting used for the game’s box art.
